case_name: Pure increases in 10% bucket + zero-tolerance violation
computation: Zero-tolerance: Appraisal 550 > 500 → excess 50; Credit report exact. 10% aggregate: ΣLE = 300+100=400; 10% threshold=40; ΣCD=350+120=470; 470-400=70 >40 → aggregate excess 30. No-limit: increase allowed. Distinction: 10% test is aggregate CD sum vs aggregate LE sum (not sum of individual increases).
violations: Zero-tolerance violation of 50 (cure required); 10% aggregate violation of 30 (cure required). Total cure 80.
weakest_point: Whether credit-report fee is always zero-tolerance when paid to affiliate (assumed yes).

case_name: Mixed directions inside 10% bucket (net increase still exceeds)
computation: Zero-tolerance: Origination exact. 10% aggregate: ΣLE=800+150+250+80=1280; 10% threshold=128; ΣCD=950+100+275+90=1415; 1415-1280=135 >128 → excess 7. Explicit distinction: do NOT sum only the increases (150+25+10=185) then apply 10%; the rule requires aggregate-vs-aggregate comparison of the entire bucket sums. Net of the decrease in pest inspection is already reflected in the ΣCD figure.
clause_basis: §1026.19(e)(3)(ii)(A) (“the aggregate amount of charges … does not exceed the aggregate amount … by more than 10 percent”); Comment 19(e)(3)(ii)-2
weakest_point: Exact classification of pest inspection as shoppable third-party (assumed permitted to shop).

case_name: Mixed directions inside 10% bucket (net decrease – no violation)
computation: Zero-tolerance: Appraisal exact. 10% aggregate: ΣLE=600+40+100+120=860; 10% threshold=86; ΣCD=720+25+75+110=930; 930-860=70 ≤86 → within tolerance. Again, mixed directions (title up 120, others down) are netted inside the single aggregate comparison; sum-of-increases alone would have been 120, but that is not the test.
weakest_point: Whether lender’s title policy is treated as shoppable under the written list (assumed yes for this illustration).

case_name: Zero-tolerance only violation; 10% clean; no-limit large increase
computation: Zero-tolerance: Origination 950>900 → excess 50; Processing exact. 10% aggregate: ΣLE=200+75=275; threshold=27.5; ΣCD=210+80=290; 290-275=15 ≤27.5 → OK. No-limit: both increases permitted if based on best information reasonably available.
violations: Zero-tolerance violation of 50 (cure 50). 10% and no-limit clean.
weakest_point: Whether processing fee paid to affiliate is correctly zero-tolerance (yes per rule).

case_name: Mixed 10% with omitted fee appearing at CD + zero clean
computation: Zero-tolerance: Appraisal exact. 10% aggregate: ΣLE=700+90+0=790; threshold=79; ΣCD=650+95+45=790; 790-790=0 ≤79 → within tolerance. Omitted fee is included in the aggregate CD sum (Comment 19(e)(3)(ii)-2). Mixed directions (settlement down, recording up, new fee) net to zero change.
clause_basis: §1026.19(e)(3)(ii)(A) and Comment 19(e)(3)(ii)-2 (omitted charges still enter the aggregate); §1026.19(e)(3)(i)
weakest_point: Whether flood certification was required and shoppable (assumed yes and therefore 10% bucket).
